senses: (bound form) signal; bugle call (e.g. 起床号)
to mark; to label; to assign a number
(bound form) name; appellation (e.g. 国号, 年号, 辽宁号)
day of the month (e.g. 七号 "the 7th")
(bound form) size; type; category (e.g. 五号电池)
(TCM) to feel (the pulse) (used in 号脉)
classifier for numbered people or items
